title: Chamber Music 2027
institution: Banff Centre for Arts and Creativity
about: Banff Centre for Arts and Creativity's Chamber Music 2027 residency runs July 5-17, 2027 in Banff, Canada, for early-career, classically trained musicians and composers aged 18+. Domestic and international applicants are welcome. Deadline: January 13, 2027, 11:59 p.m. Mountain Standard Time.
requirements: Early-career, classically trained musicians in post-secondary or postgraduate study, or recent graduates
String, woodwind, brass, piano, percussion and composition applicants; two positions reserved for composers
card_alt: Card for Chamber Music 2027 at the Banff Centre for Arts and Creativity in Banff, Canada, application deadline 13 Jan 2027. The background photo shows the Gooderham Building and downtown Toronto, not Banff.
